skill.name: 1password-credential-lookup
skill.description: Looks up 1Password login items by website URL and optional username using the local 1Password CLI.
skill.summary: Finds 1Password website credentials by domain for agent-assisted login workflows.
skill.author: ClementWalter

security_audit.summary: The skill is intentionally designed to retrieve 1Password login data and can print passwords through the local op CLI. Most SKILL.md backtick findings are false positives from Markdown examples, but the underlying capability gives agents direct access to high-value secrets. Publication should require explicit user approval, output redaction, and safer domain matching.

remediation.suggestion: Do not return passwords directly to the AI transcript. Require explicit user approval and prefer secure autofill or redacted handoff.
Require confirmation for each domain and account before retrieving a secret. Document that unrelated domains must never be requested.
Parse URL hostnames and compare registered domains exactly. Add tests for lookalike domains and subdomain boundaries.
Keep shell execution disabled, validate allowed op subcommands, and avoid logging command output that may contain secrets.

content.value_statement: Agents often need the correct login item for a website without guessing vault item names. This skill searches 1Password by domain and optional username through the local CLI.
actual_capabilities: Searches 1Password items by the URL field stored in each item.
Filters results by username when multiple accounts exist for a domain.
Returns username, password, item name, and item ID for a single match.
Lists matching account names and usernames when several items match.
Normalizes HTTP, HTTPS, and path components before searching domains.
Treats x.com and twitter.com as equivalent domains.
limitations: Requires the local 1Password CLI to be installed and signed in.
Can expose plaintext passwords to the agent output and logs.
Only finds items that include URL fields matching the requested domain.
Uses limited alias handling and substring domain matching.

use_cases.title: Developer login support
use_cases.description: A developer asks an agent to sign in to a test service while choosing the correct vault item by domain.

use_cases.title: Operations account selection
use_cases.description: An operations user lists matching accounts for a shared service before selecting a specific username.

use_cases.title: QA environment access
use_cases.description: A QA tester retrieves credentials for staging sites where several accounts share the same website domain.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by username
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the 1Password credential lookup for example.com with username qa@example.com.

prompt_templates.title: Choose among accounts
prompt_templates.prompt: List available 1Password accounts for example.com, then retrieve the account I select.

prompt_templates.title: Login workflow with checks
prompt_templates.prompt: For example.com, confirm the domain, find the matching 1Password item, and use only the selected account for login.

output_examples.output: One matching item is found. The response includes the selected item name, username, and password for the login form.

output_examples.input: Find credentials for github.com with no username when several accounts exist.
output_examples.output: The skill reports that several accounts match and asks the user to choose a username.
No matching item is found. The user should check the domain spelling or add the site URL to the vault item.

best_practices: Ask the user to confirm the target domain before retrieving any password.
Use a username filter when several accounts exist for the same website.
Avoid storing or repeating returned passwords outside the active login task.
anti_patterns: Do not guess item names when the website URL is available.
Do not request credentials for domains unrelated to the current user task.
Do not paste returned passwords into messages, tickets, or logs.

faq.question: Does this skill require 1Password CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. The local op CLI must be installed, unlocked, and authenticated before lookup works.

faq.question: Does it search by item name?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow searches by the URL field stored on 1Password items.

faq.question: Can it handle multiple accounts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can list matching usernames and then filter lookup by the selected username.

faq.question: Does it support domain aliases?
faq.answer: It treats x.com and twitter.com as equivalent. Other aliases are not included.

faq.question: Is password output redacted?
faq.answer: No. The script can return plaintext passwords, so users should treat outputs as sensitive.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
